senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文应写作 Conlon。本条识别其姓氏用法，不据此推断输入所指的具体人物、性别、国籍或身份；缺少可靠的特定姓名读音，因此音标保留为 null。下列搭配是姓名使用格式。[爱尔兰姓氏索引](https://www.duchas.ie/en/surnames?SearchText=Conlon)。

etymology.historical_story: Conlon illustrates how a surname can enter a Malay text without becoming a Malay vocabulary word. The Irish surname index associates this spelling with several Irish forms, rather than a single uncontested origin. Its appearance therefore preserves a person's name, not a transferable everyday meaning. Learning it as an intact name avoids inventing a Malay root or misleading literal translation. [Surname index](https://www.duchas.ie/en/surnames?SearchText=Conlon).
